rappel_detail.anchor: not described; inspect any slings and back up
rappel_detail.station: The top of the West Peak summit block, at the head of the northwest edge.
rappel_detail.notes: One rappel of 25-30 m down the northwest edge to a belay ledge, then scramble and downclimb to rejoin the standard East Face ramps descent.
rappel_detail.pull: Needs a 60 m rope used doubled: a 30 m rope reaches only 15 m doubled, and a 50 m reaches 25 m with nothing to spare.
